_guide: Crew reactions: after an authored episode, one crew member reacts in a line. Groups are react_<mood>; the episode's "mood" (or the story's) picks the group. Lines with a "when" fit someone with that trait and are picked first.
In the text {Crew} is the person reacting. Start sentences with {Crew}, and use {crew.they} only straight before {crew:verb|verbs}.

react_wonder: {Crew} doesn't say anything for a long time. Later, {crew.they} {crew:writes|write} three pages about it and won't let anyone read them.
{Crew} whispers "oh", just that, and it says everything.
{Crew} stands at the window long after everyone else has gone to bed.

react_wonder.text: {Crew} says {crew.they} {crew:has|have} read about places like this, and not one of the books got it right.
{Crew} already has a notebook out and is sketching it from four different angles.
{Crew} has tears in {crew.their} eyes and blames the wind.
{Crew} declares it the most beautiful thing in the galaxy, then corrects {crew.themself}: the second most. {Crew} won't say what the first is.
{Crew} goes very quiet and very happy, the way {crew.they} {crew:does|do} when {crew.they} {crew:is|are} dreaming awake.

react_eerie: {Crew} keeps glancing over {crew.their} shoulder for the rest of the day.
Nobody says it out loud, but {Crew} is the one who leaves the galley light on all night.

react_eerie.text: {Crew} checks the airlock three times before bed, then once more, just to be sure.
{Crew} volunteers to go first next time. {Crew} doesn't look scared. {Crew} looks very determined not to look scared.
{Crew} knocks on the hull twice and won't explain why.
{Crew} tries to make a joke about it. Nobody laughs, including {Crew}.
{Crew} writes it all down very carefully, as if writing it down might make it less strange. It doesn't.

react_warm: {Crew} is smiling at nothing for the rest of the evening.
{Crew} makes everyone a cup of tea without being asked, which is how {crew.they} {crew:says|say} I love you.

react_warm.text: {Crew} insists the moment calls for cake, and somehow there is cake.
{Crew} tells the story back to the crew at dinner, three times, improving it each time.
Even {Crew} admits, gruffly, that it was nice. Then {Crew} goes to bed early so nobody can mention it.
{Crew} hugs whoever is nearest, which turns out to be the ship's doorframe.

react_tense: {Crew} doesn't sleep much. {Crew} sits by the window going over it again and again.
{Crew} has started making lists. Lists of what could go wrong. Lists of what to do if it does.

react_tense.text: {Crew} is the calm one. Somebody has to be.
{Crew} treats it like a race to win, which, honestly, helps everyone.
{Crew} paces the corridor until somebody gently takes {crew.their} arm and walks with {crew.them}.
{Crew} tidies the whole galley twice. It is the only thing {crew.they} can control.

react_sad: {Crew} goes quiet and stays quiet. Later, {crew.they} {crew:asks|ask} if anyone wants to sit together for a bit. Everyone does.
{Crew} doesn't eat much at dinner, and nobody pushes.

react_sad.text: {Crew} writes a long letter home that night, about nothing in particular.
{Crew} cries, openly, and nobody pretends not to notice. Somebody passes {crew.them} a blanket.
{Crew} sits with whoever looks saddest and says nothing at all, which is exactly right.

react_funny: {Crew} laughs so hard {crew.they} {crew:has|have} to sit down on the floor.

react_funny.text: {Crew} trips over the threshold on the way out, which somehow makes it even funnier.
{Crew} acts the whole thing out again in the galley, with voices.
{Crew} pretends to be unamused for nearly a whole minute.

react_determined.text: {Crew} has decided it's going to work, and once {Crew} has decided something, the universe usually gives up.
{Crew} is up before anyone else, already working.
{Crew} doesn't say anything. {Crew} just picks up the heaviest thing and starts carrying it.

react_quiet: {Crew} spends the evening looking out of the window, thinking.

react_quiet.text: {Crew} sits up late on the bridge, watching the stars over {world}.
{Crew} reads in the window seat until the light goes, and then a little longer.
{Crew} hums one of the old songs under {crew.their} breath all evening.
